maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.text: The installation is in maintenance: a backup is being restored. Afterwards you sign in again.
maintenance.checking: This page checks every few seconds whether it is over.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Backups of the whole installation: database and attachments in one archive. Only owners see this page.

archives.title: Archives
archives.description: The archives in the backup directory. Upload an archive of another installation here.
archives.name: Name

check.title: Check of {{name}}
check.keyBlocked: This installation's key does not fit the archive: its encrypted values would be unreadable. Restoring is blocked.
check.fine: The archive is unchanged and fits this installation.
check.blocked: Restoring is blocked while the check reports problems.

replace.title: Replace the installation
replace.text: Everything in this installation is replaced by the state of the archive {{name}}. The present state is backed up first. While restoring, the installation is in maintenance; afterwards everyone is signed out.
replace.confirm: Type the organisation's name to confirm: {{org}}
replace.started: Restoring: the present state is backed up first, then maintenance begins.
replace.failed: The last restore ({{name}}) failed: {{reason}}. The previous state is unchanged.

export.title: Single spaces
export.text: A single space can be exported as a Markdown ZIP at any time: in the space under “Import/Export” → “Export space (ZIP)”. It does not replace a backup of the installation.

archive.checksum: The archive was changed after the backup (checksum differs).
archive.format_unknown: Not a backup archive of this format.
archive.member_missing: A part of the archive is missing.
archive.member_checksum: A part of the archive was changed.

restore.archive_newer: The archive comes from a newer version.
restore.file_conflict: A file of the archive is here already with other content.
restore.storage_unavailable: The file storage does not answer.
restore.server_too_old: The PostgreSQL server is older than the archive's.
restore.tools_too_old: pg_restore is older than the archive's pg_dump.
restore.secret_key_mismatch: The key (HERD_SECRET_KEY) does not fit the archive.
restore.secret_key_missing: The archive has encrypted values and no key is set here.
restore.env_missing: The environment variable {{detail}} is not set here.
restore.safety_backup_failed: Backing up the present state failed ({{detail}}).
restore.already_running: Another restore or a migration is running.
restore.confirm_mismatch: The organisation's name does not match.
restore.finish_failed: A step after the restore failed; the installation stays in maintenance.
restore.not_schema_owner: With separate database roles the app itself may not restore; that works only on the command line with the migration role (docs/SICHERUNG.md).

backup.interrupted: The process ended before it finished.
backup.in_restored_archive: Was running when the restored archive was made.
backup.storage_unavailable: The file storage does not answer.
backup.io: Writing into the backup directory failed.
backup.verify_failed: The archive was faulty when read back.
backup.tools_too_old: pg_dump is older than the server.
backup.schema_behind: The database is not at this version's state.
backup.schema_ahead: The database is newer than this version.

backup.already_running: A backup is running or waiting for the worker.
backup.confirm_mismatch: The name does not match the organisation's name.
backup.replace_refused: The check reports problems: restoring is blocked.
backup.archive_invalid: The file is not a valid backup archive.
backup.upload_too_large: The archive is larger than this installation accepts (HERD_BACKUP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES).
backup.not_found: This archive does not exist (any more).
